review_runs.investigation: Private annotation plus generic export composition
review_runs.result: Static model recommends capability-shaped destination projections, pre-derivation filtering, conservative derivation restrictions, separated owner archive/audience disclosure, and a new effective invocation plan for every composed candidate.
review_runs.evidence_state: Static counterexample and ten proposed runtime cases; no Agora enforcement implementation was executed.

review_runs.investigation: Whether the M1 single-verb path is shaped to become the security choke point
review_runs.result: It is not yet load-bearing: protected file I/O precedes checks, the checks omit operation constraints, and the unauthenticated browser surface can reach the path. For M1, a synthetic ingress root and launch authentication are recommended; resource-bound import tickets remain with the later host-side spine.

findings.gate: Before real sensitive data or untrusted content
findings.summary: JEFF can request arbitrary host paths; mint/attach resolve and persist file bytes before authority/grant checks, then desk projection may send imported text to the remote model provider.
Loopback HTTP and SSE endpoints have no launch authentication or origin/host checks, and /verb accepts a caller-supplied actor.
The check stubs receive only actor, verb, and entity, so they cannot bind future policy to facet, source resource, revision, payload, scene, destination, or budget.
Direct core.scene replacement and recursive projection can bypass place semantics and create persistent cycles; shared Store.sync has no lock around last_applied plus tail application.

review_runs.evidence_state: Static review of named files and committed tests. No project code, tests, model calls, exploit, or credential content executed or read.
